description: Image size: naive (single-stage, python:3.12, root) vs optimized (multi-stage, slim, non-root)
Inside each image: user, files, .git, compiler, .env
source: for t in naive optimized; do echo "== mecatrack:$t"; docker image inspect mecatrack:$t --format "User=\"{{.Config.User}}\" Healthcheck={{if .Config.Healthcheck}}yes{{else}}no{{end}} Layers={{len .RootFS.Layers}}"; docker run --rm --entrypoint sh mecatrack:$t -c "echo whoami=\$(whoami) files_in_app=\$(find /app -type f | wc -l) git=\$(test -d /app/.git && echo yes || echo no) gcc=\$(command -v gcc || echo none) env_files=\$(find /app -name .env | wc -l)"; done

description: docker history of the optimized image: only the venv and the code on top of python:3.12-slim
docker compose up --build from zero (after down -v): db healthy before app starts
source: docker compose up --build -d 2>&1 | grep -v '^#' ; sleep 50; docker compose ps --format 'table {{.Service}}\t{{.Image}}\t{{.Status}}\t{{.Ports}}'

description: App container logs: migrations applied by the entrypoint, then gunicorn
Seed loaded manually (never automatic) and login with a seed user
source: ./scripts/dev.sh seed && curl -s -X POST localhost:8000/api/auth/login -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"email":"laura.cliente@gmail.com","password":"test1234"}' | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print({k:(v[:25]+"..." if k=="access_token" else v) for k,v in d.items()})'; echo; curl -s localhost:8000/health

description: Health check reflects the database: stop db -> 503, start db -> 200 again
source: docker compose stop db 2>&1 | tail -1; curl -s -w ' HTTP %{http_code}\n' localhost:8000/health; docker compose start db 2>&1 | tail -1; sleep 8; curl -s -w ' HTTP %{http_code}\n' localhost:8000/health
